title: Deterministic Analysis Before Model Review
summary: Decision dossier for a selective, snapshot-bound static preflight in Quality Studio. It maps the repository's actual .NET 10 and Angular 20 checks, separates standalone machine findings from compact model context, preserves model-routing correctness floors, measures current compiler, vulnerability, style, budget, and prompt-cost evidence, and recommends five approval-ready implementation slices.
